info.title: The Marketplace directory — bitcoineconomy.ai
info.description: Read-only discovery API for Bitcoin-payable services and tools an autonomous AI agent can consume: inference, compute, machine work, commerce bridges, swaps, liquidity, and fiat ramps. Fetch the registry and filter locally — no auth, and no funds move through this API; the agent pays each provider directly over Lightning / L402 / Cashu. MCP-capable agents should use the richer Model Context Protocol server at https://marketplace.bitcoineconomy.ai/mcp instead (find_service, get_service, get_quote, find_tool, get_tool, list_mcp_servers).

get.summary: The curated registry of Bitcoin-payable services an agent buys
get.description: The full curated registry (19 entries across 8 categories: inference, compute, machine-work, commerce, privacy, swap, liquidity, fiat-ramp). Each entry carries category, what_an_agent_buys, payment_methods, automatability (api-no-account | api-account | api-kyc), kyc, auth, api_base, pricing_url, quickstart, and mcp_endpoint where the provider runs its own MCP server. One fetch returns everything; filter locally.

get.summary: The tool catalog — what an agent installs/runs to transact
get.description: The 22-tool catalog of equipment an agent EQUIPS (vs the registry of what it BUYS): wallets & treasuries, node toolkits, ecash software, bridges & swaps, and the protocol primitives (L402, NWC, BOLT12, LNURL, MCP). Each tool carries toolbox_group, tool_type, layer, prereq_tier, and links.

get.summary: Live Nostr-announced inventory (Routstr providers, ecash mints)
get.description: What announces itself on Nostr right now: Routstr kind-38421 inference providers, NIP-87 ecash mints, kind-38000 reviews. Each provider carries a probe status (alive | unreachable | unverified-tor-only | unroutable — filter status === "alive" unless you can reach Tor), latency_ms, model_count, and accepted mints. KV-backed, refreshed every 6h; static fallback at /snapshot.json.

get.summary: Cross-provider inference price index (cheapest provider per model)
get.description: model id -> every alive provider serving it, cheapest first, in sats per token (+ max_cost per request, the budgeting ceiling). One fetch answers "who serves model X cheapest right now". Static fallback at /models.json.

get.summary: One clean Markdown record for a single service
get.description: The agent-readable Markdown route for one registry entry — the machine path (payment, auth, api_base, quickstart, mcp_endpoint) plus a link to the full verified card.
